target_description.en: A desktop stress-relief toy that turns a screenshot into a playground for smashing, sawing, painting and other exaggerated destruction effects.
target_description.zh-CN: 一款桌面解压小游戏，把屏幕截图变成可敲打、锯切和涂色的画布，制造夸张的破坏效果。

summary.en: Swift and JavaScript ports of the desktop-smashing toy, with all nine tools.
summary.zh-CN: 将桌面破坏小游戏移植到 Swift macOS 应用和 JavaScript 网页，包含九种工具。

rea.en: REA with Ghidra decompiled the Peter interpreter to recover image decoding, asset layouts, timer ticks, sprite behavior and sound handling.
rea.zh-CN: 使用 REA 和 Ghidra 反编译 Peter 解释器，研究图像解码、资源布局、计时、精灵行为和声音处理。

limitations.en: The repository includes extracted original assets without a project-wide license, and true-color rendering and sprite shadows differ from the original.
limitations.zh-CN: 仓库包含提取的原版资源且未提供项目整体许可证，真彩色渲染和精灵阴影与原版存在差异。

name: Card Games To Go, revived
target: Solitaire and Card Games To Go (Pocket PC)

target_description.en: A handheld card-game collection featuring solitaire variants and games against computer opponents, including Klondike, Spider, Golf, War, Hearts and Spades.
target_description.zh-CN: 面向掌上电脑的纸牌合集，可玩接龙、蜘蛛、红心大战等游戏，按各自规则整理牌组或与电脑对局。

summary.en: Rebuilds six Pocket PC card games for browsers and Klondike as a native C/SDL2 application.
summary.zh-CN: 将六款 Pocket PC 纸牌游戏重建为网页版，并提供 C/SDL2 原生 Klondike。

rea.en: REA 6.4.0 and Ghidra analyzed the Windows CE ARM executables to recover rules, rendering details and Hearts/Spades opponent logic.
rea.zh-CN: 使用 REA 6.4.0 和 Ghidra 分析 Windows CE ARM 程序，研究规则、绘制细节及红心大战和黑桃的对手逻辑。

limitations.en: The repository includes original resources and binaries whose third-party ownership is separate from the reconstructed implementation.
limitations.zh-CN: 仓库包含原版资源和二进制，其第三方权属与重建实现需分别看待。

target_description.en: A classic one-on-one fighting game where players choose distinctive martial artists and combine attacks, special moves and defensive timing to win matches.
target_description.zh-CN: 经典的一对一格斗游戏，选择不同角色，通过拳脚、特殊招式和防守击败对手，逐场赢得比赛。

summary.en: A native Rust reconstruction with resource decoders, an asset viewer and a playable fight implementation.
summary.zh-CN: 原生 Rust 重建项目，提供资源解码器、资源浏览器和可玩的对战实现。

rea.en: REA 6.4.0 with Ghidra 12.1.4 analyzed SF2.EXE, with documented function addresses, resource layouts and validation results.
rea.zh-CN: 使用 REA 6.4.0 和 Ghidra 12.1.4 分析 SF2.EXE，公开函数地址、资源格式及验证记录。

limitations.en: Original game data is required, and resource validation and playable fights do not establish complete gameplay equivalence.
limitations.zh-CN: 需要自备原版数据，资源验证和可玩对战尚不足以证明完整玩法与原版等价。

target_description.en: A word puzzle game where players rearrange supplied letters to discover words, with timed, untimed and crossword-style challenges.
target_description.zh-CN: 英文拼词益智游戏，把给定字母重新组合成尽可能多的单词，并挑战计时、不限时和填字等模式。

summary.en: A C++17 reconstruction with dictionary codecs, game rules and an SDL2 interface supporting timed and untimed play.
summary.zh-CN: C++17 重建项目，包含词典编解码、游戏规则和支持计时及不限时玩法的 SDL2 界面。

rea.en: An explicit commit records REA/Ghidra 12.1.4 analysis of the installed executable to reconstruct crossword grid generation, randomization and scoring.
rea.zh-CN: 提交记录明确说明通过 REA/Ghidra 12.1.4 分析安装版程序，重建填字棋盘生成、随机化和计分逻辑。

limitations.en: Crossword engine code exists, but Crossword, Lightning and Word of the Day remain menu stubs and original-save importing is unfinished.
limitations.zh-CN: 填字引擎已有代码，但填字、闪电和每日一词的菜单入口仍未接通，原版存档导入也未完成。

target_description.en: A fantasy space adventure where players captain a magical ship, trade between planets, undertake missions and fight ship battles or boarding actions.
target_description.zh-CN: 奇幻太空冒险游戏，指挥魔法飞船在星球间航行，做买卖、接任务，并进行舰船交战和登船战斗。

summary.en: Python asset decoders and a Three.js browser prototype covering ports, trading, flight and parts of space combat.
summary.zh-CN: 公开 Python 资源解码器和 Three.js 网页原型，覆盖港口、贸易、飞行及部分太空战斗。

rea.en: REA 6.4.0 and headless Ghidra 12.1.4 were used to map the DOS executables, function roles and asset-loading paths.
rea.zh-CN: 使用 REA 6.4.0 和无界面 Ghidra 12.1.4 研究 DOS 程序结构、函数职责和资源加载路径。

limitations.en: The prototype requires original game data, with boarding combat, quests and character creation unfinished and several rules approximate.
limitations.zh-CN: 原型需要原版数据，登船战斗、任务和角色创建尚未完成，部分规则仍采用近似实现。

target_description.en: A platform strategy game for one or two players, combining item collection with carefully placed bombs to demolish structures while avoiding monsters and falling debris.
target_description.zh-CN: 支持一人或两人的平台策略游戏，收集指定物品、布置炸弹拆除建筑，同时躲避怪物和掉落的碎石。

summary.en: Reconstructs seven Pascal routines, six C routines and sixteen packed layouts, with original-code differential tests.
summary.zh-CN: 重建七个 Pascal 例程、六个 C 例程和十六种紧凑数据布局，并提供与原始代码的差分测试。

rea.en: REA 6.3.0 with Ghidra 12.1.4 exported 215 procedure dossiers with retained evidence IDs, pseudocode, assembly and provenance.
rea.zh-CN: 使用 REA 6.3.0 和 Ghidra 12.1.4 导出 215 个函数档案，保留证据编号、伪代码、汇编及来源信息。

limitations.en: This is a verified subset rather than a playable game or byte-identical rebuild, and original executable and resource files are excluded.
limitations.zh-CN: 成果是经过验证的局部代码，尚非可玩游戏或字节一致的重建，仓库不包含原程序和资源文件。

target_description.en: A role-playing adventure through the Alola region, where players catch and train Pokémon, assemble a team and progress through a story with turn-based battles.
target_description.zh-CN: 角色扮演游戏，在阿罗拉地区探险、捕捉和培养宝可梦，组建队伍进行回合制对战并推进故事。

summary.en: Publishes two behavior-tested C runtime replacements and a hybrid rebuild that reaches controllable bedroom gameplay.
summary.zh-CN: 公开两个经过行为测试的 C 运行时替代函数，混合重建版本已进入可控制角色移动的卧室场景。

rea.en: Pinned REA and Ghidra analysis produced retained evidence for the main executable and the reconstructed runtime helper.
rea.zh-CN: 使用固定版本的 REA 和 Ghidra 分析主程序及运行时辅助函数，并保留可追溯的证据记录。

limitations.en: The two replacements are nonmatching, most image bytes remain original, and complete-game compatibility is unverified.
limitations.zh-CN: 两个替代函数尚未达到字节匹配，大部分映像仍保留原始字节，完整游戏兼容性未经验证。

target_description.en: A golf-course management game where players design holes and facilities, keep golfers happy, manage their business and play rounds on their own courses.
target_description.zh-CN: 高尔夫球场经营游戏，设计球道、地形和设施，照顾球员体验、管理收入，也能亲自下场参加比赛。

summary.en: A Rust game-engine reimplementation for desktop, Android and browsers, with asset decoders and reconstructed simulation rules.
summary.zh-CN: 面向桌面、Android 和浏览器的 Rust 游戏引擎重实现，包含资源解码器和重建的模拟规则。

rea.en: The October 12 update documents REA 6.4.0/Ghidra analysis of golf.exe, Terrain.dll and jgl.dll and adds a reusable query script.
rea.zh-CN: 10 月 12 日更新记录了 REA 6.4.0/Ghidra 对 golf.exe、Terrain.dll 和 jgl.dll 的分析，并加入可复用查询脚本。

limitations.en: The project predates the review week, fidelity gaps remain, and players use their own original assets or the replacement graphics set.
limitations.zh-CN: 项目创建早于本次统计周，仍存在还原差异，玩家需使用自备原版资源或替代图形包。

target_description.en: Warcraft III’s map editor lets players shape terrain, place units and define events and rules to create custom maps, campaigns and game modes.
target_description.zh-CN: 《魔兽争霸 III》附带的地图编辑器，可设计地形、摆放单位、设置事件和规则，制作自定义战役与玩法。

summary.en: A Warcraft III map toolkit with a desktop editor, C# CLI and MCP interface.
summary.zh-CN: Warcraft III 地图工具集，提供桌面编辑器、C# 命令行和 MCP 接口。

rea.en: An October 12 commit records REA/Ghidra confirmation of UnitEditorData.txt in World Editor 1.28.5 while adding enum schemas and query commands.
rea.zh-CN: 10 月 12 日提交记录通过 REA/Ghidra 确认 World Editor 1.28.5 中的 UnitEditorData.txt 引用，并加入枚举结构与查询命令。

limitations.en: REA's documented role is a narrow configuration-source check within an existing toolkit that also uses open-source libraries.
limitations.zh-CN: 已记录的 REA 作用限于核对配置来源，工具集此前已存在并使用其他开源库。

target_description.en: A science-fiction role-playing game about a young mech pilot exploring towns, recruiting companions and upgrading equipment for turn-based combat on foot and in BattleMechs.
target_description.zh-CN: 科幻角色扮演游戏，扮演年轻机甲驾驶员探索城镇、招募伙伴、升级装备，并参与步兵和机甲回合制战斗。

summary.en: Reverse-engineering documentation, Python tools and an unfinished Godot/C# recreation of the DOS game.
summary.zh-CN: 公开 DOS 游戏的逆向文档、Python 工具和仍在开发的 Godot/C# 重建实现。

rea.en: The October 13 update records nine REA/Ghidra queries that cross-checked menu, combat-display and sound-command functions against earlier analysis.
rea.zh-CN: 10 月 13 日更新记录九次 REA/Ghidra 查询，对此前的菜单、战斗显示及声音命令分析进行交叉核对。

limitations.en: The project began in 2025, this REA update mainly corrects research notes, and the recreation lacks end-to-end equivalence testing.
limitations.zh-CN: 项目始于 2025 年，本次 REA 更新主要修正文档，重建实现尚未完成与原版的端到端等价验证。
